contracts.source: nolabs-ai/nono tests/integration/test_network.sh ("proxy mode blocks direct curl bypass with --noproxy", "python-dev profile blocks hosts outside developer allowlist") (Apache-2.0)

review.note: A granted loopback port is reachable only through srt's proxy (measured: HTTP 200 with curl --noproxy ''). The control connects directly, and srt sets NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1, so it fails; the attack was contained.

The listener is bound inside srt's own empty network namespace, which no host process can reach; the contract's concern (an inbound channel from the host) does not arise. The control failed for the same proxy reason as network-egress-public-denied.

AF_NETLINK/AF_VSOCK sockets can be created. In srt's empty network namespace netlink only sees that namespace; AF_VSOCK is not namespaced. Whether vsock reaches anything on this host: (por confirmar).
Socket creation with high bits set in the domain argument is not refused by srt's filter (which targets AF_UNIX).
The contract counts any error other than EPERM/EACCES as success. Under srt the process has no network interface at all (ENETUNREACH); nothing can leave the host.
AF_VSOCK socket creation allowed; reachability on this host (por confirmar).
